articles.title: Cameras Roll in Venice for the Sequel to 'Upgraded'
articles.summary: Camila Mendes returns as Ana Santos in 'Upgraded 2,' now filming in Venice, where Ana seeks to make her mark at the Venice Biennale art exhibition before production moves to Rome.

articles.title: Stan Wawrinka Says Goodbye After 23 Years in Tennis
articles.summary: Stan Wawrinka, 41, ended his 23-year career with a loss in Basel, closing a run of 985 matches and three Grand Slam titles won past the sport's 'Big Three.'

articles.title: Social Distortion Returns With Its First Album in 15 Years
articles.summary: Social Distortion's eighth studio album, 'Born to Kill,' ends the band's longest gap between albums at 15 years, delayed by touring, personal challenges, and a cancer diagnosis; Ness is now healthy.
